purpose: Define coverage over canonical contracts, operations, states, error paths, permissions, protocol surfaces and migrations without claiming untested behavior from a percentage alone.

topics.name: Verification Coverage Evidence
topics.purpose: Define coverage over canonical contracts, operations, states, error paths, permissions, protocol surfaces and migrations without claiming untested behavior from a percentage alone.

semantics.identity_rule: Each coverage evaluation has explicit identity.
semantics.source_rule: Coverage derives from exact test suite/run/result mapping.
semantics.percentage_rule: Numeric coverage is descriptive evidence, not correctness proof.
semantics.gap_rule: Untested required semantics are explicit gaps.
semantics.authority_rule: Coverage threshold pass grants no deployment rights.

invariants.rule: Test definitions, fixtures, results, coverage, simulations and release evidence never become production semantic authority or grant production execution rights merely by existing or passing.
Verification evidence binds exact test/profile/source/runtime revisions and declared environment inputs so a pass/fail result cannot silently float across unrelated versions or targets.

hard_gates.condition: 100 percent coverage claimed proof of correctness

references.purpose: Coverage maps exact test suites/cases to semantics.
